description: This file contains implementation of methods related to YAML atom processing, including atom filling, advancing, formatting, and iteration. It defines functions for parsing, formatting, and inspecting YAML atoms, as well as managing atom iterators and line analysis.

classes.name: struct fy_atom
classes.description: Represents a YAML atom, encapsulating its data, style, marks, and properties.

classes.name: struct fy_reader
classes.description: Provides methods for reading and advancing through YAML input streams.

classes.name: struct fy_mark
classes.description: Holds positional information (line, column, input position) within the input stream.

classes.name: struct fy_atom_iter
classes.description: Manages iteration over YAML atom content, supporting chunked reading and line analysis.

classes.name: struct fy_atom_iter_line_info
classes.description: Contains detailed information about individual lines within an atom for processing purposes.

classes.name: struct fy_iter_chunk
classes.description: Defines a chunk of atom data for incremental reading.

methods.name: struct:fy_atom * fy_reader_fill_atom(struct fy_reader * fyr,int advance,struct fy_atom * handle)
methods.description: Fills an fy_atom structure with data from the reader, optionally advancing the input.

methods.name: int fy_reader_advance_mark(struct fy_reader * fyr,int advance,struct fy_mark * m)
methods.description: Advances the input position in the reader by a specified number of characters, updating mark info.

methods.name: struct:fy_atom * fy_reader_fill_atom_mark(struct fy_reader * fyr,const struct fy_mark * start_mark,const struct fy_mark * end_mark,struct fy_atom * handle)
methods.description: Fills an fy_atom with start and end marks, capturing input position info.

methods.name: struct:fy_atom * fy_reader_fill_atom_at(struct fy_reader * fyr,int advance,int count,struct fy_atom * handle)
methods.description: Creates an fy_atom covering a specified range by advancing input marks.

methods.name: void fy_atom_iter_start(const struct fy_atom * atom,struct fy_atom_iter * iter)
methods.description: Initializes an atom iterator for traversing atom data, analyzing lines for formatting.

methods.name: void fy_atom_iter_finish(struct fy_atom_iter * iter)
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by an atom iterator.

methods.name: int fy_atom_memcmp(struct fy_atom * atom,const void * ptr,size_t len)
methods.description: Compares the atom's data with a given memory region.

methods.name: int fy_atom_strcmp(struct fy_atom * atom,const char * str)
methods.description: Compares the atom's data with a null-terminated string.

methods.name: bool fy_atom_is_number(struct fy_atom * atom)
methods.description: Determines if the atom's content represents a number.

methods.name: int fy_atom_cmp(struct fy_atom * atom1,struct fy_atom * atom2)
methods.description: Lexicographically compares two atoms.

methods.name: const struct fy_raw_line * fy_atom_raw_line_iter_next(struct fy_atom_raw_line_iter * iter)
methods.description: Returns the next raw line from atom for low-level line parsing.

methods.name: void fy_atom_raw_line_iter_start(const struct fy_atom * atom,struct fy_atom_raw_line_iter * iter)
methods.description: Initializes a line iterator over an atom.

methods.name: void fy_atom_raw_line_iter_finish(struct fy_atom_raw_line_iter * iter)
methods.description: Finalizes the raw line iterator.

methods.name: int fy_atom_format_text_length(struct fy_atom * atom)
methods.description: Calculates and caches the textual length of an atom's content.

methods.name: const char * fy_atom_format_text(struct fy_atom * atom,char * buf,size_t maxsz)
methods.description: Formats the atom's content into a provided buffer.

methods.name: int fy_atom_format_utf8_length(struct fy_atom * atom)
methods.description: Calculates the UTF-8 character length of the atom's content.

methods.name: const struct fy_iter_chunk * fy_atom_iter_chunk_next(struct fy_atom_iter * iter,const struct fy_iter_chunk * curr,int * errp)
methods.description: Retrieves the next data chunk from the atom iterator.

methods.name: ssize_t fy_atom_iter_read(struct fy_atom_iter * iter,void * buf,size_t count)
methods.description: Reads data from the atom iterator into a buffer.

methods.name: int fy_atom_iter_getc(struct fy_atom_iter * iter)
methods.description: Gets the next character from the atom iterator.

methods.name: int fy_atom_iter_ungetc(struct fy_atom_iter * iter,int c)
methods.description: Pushes back a character to the atom iterator.

methods.name: int fy_atom_iter_peekc(struct fy_atom_iter * iter)
methods.description: Peeks at the next character in the atom iterator without consuming it.

methods.name: int fy_atom_iter_utf8_get(struct fy_atom_iter * iter)
methods.description: Retrieves the next UTF-8 character from the atom iterator.

methods.name: int fy_atom_iter_utf8_quoted_get(struct fy_atom_iter * iter,size_t * lenp,uint8_t * buf)
methods.description: Retrieves a quoted UTF-8 character with length info.

methods.name: int fy_atom_iter_utf8_unget(struct fy_atom_iter * iter,int c)
methods.description: Pushes back a UTF-8 character into the iterator.

methods.name: int fy_atom_iter_utf8_peek(struct fy_atom_iter * iter)
methods.description: Peeks at the next UTF-8 character without advancing.
